facts.summary: Large resale registration and going-concern doubt after failed migraine trials · Phase 2 · ABP-450 in migraine · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The sale of securities being offered in this prospectus could result in adverse effects on the market for our Common Stock
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: However, our Phase 2 clinical trials for episodic and chronic migraine did not meet their respective primary endpoints.
evidence.program_discontinued: In May 2024, we announced the discontinuation of our Phase 2 clinical trials for episodic and chronic migraine in order to implement certain cash preservation measures.
